issues.legal_issue: A delayed change report under the Maharashtra Public Trusts Act may be accepted after condonation of delay, including through an order that treats the delay as condoned without a separate written order.
Failure to submit a change report within the prescribed period does not automatically invalidate a person’s assumption of office as a trust administrator or the underlying change in the trust.
Devotees who are not members of the founder’s family and have no legitimate interest in succession to the administrator’s office cannot challenge change reports concerning that succession.
Alleged improper care of a temple is not a ground to challenge change reports concerning a trust’s administrator and trustees, where separate statutory remedies address that grievance.
